name: rustfs-mimalloc-sys
reviewNotes: Published crate archive SHA-256 fb16ad68f96883407a75cdb88252b43dc2ea592428f0fc54ff7885756de4b814. Exact source: https://github.com/houseme/rustfs-mimalloc/tree/fb6fce06ebd992f7af476a5009fc35f61d3c2cfe (tag v0.7.3). The package declares Apache-2.0 but omits its root LICENSE. Retain the exact revision's LICENSE, fetched from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/houseme/rustfs-mimalloc/fb6fce06ebd992f7af476a5009fc35f61d3c2cfe/LICENSE, including houseme copyright, Apache grant, patent terms and disclaimer. No root NOTICE file exists at that revision. Third-party source is unmodified. Also retain the packaged Microsoft Corporation/Daan Leijen MIT copyright, permission and disclaimer. All 89 packaged native include/src/LICENSE files match Microsoft mimalloc commit 56dc5eb80145f9a3ba7ca23d47c6a248b9d8586c (tag v3.6.1) byte-for-byte; no upstream include/src file is missing. That commit is the wrapper revision's submodule pin and the official v3.6.1 release. Source: https://github.com/microsoft/mimalloc/tree/56dc5eb80145f9a3ba7ca23d47c6a248b9d8586c. LICENSE is unchanged since v3.5.3. Every C source and header names Microsoft Research and Daan Leijen (the Emscripten primitive also Alon Zakai) under that MIT license, except the Windows-only etw.h, a Message Compiler output carrying a Microsoft Corporation copyright, unchanged since v3.5.3 and not compiled for the musl targets that use this crate; the readme, etw.man and etw-mimalloc.wprp files carry no header. Both Apache-2.0 wrapper and MIT native obligations apply. The workspace enables only no_profile, which compiles native 30601 with MI_PROFILE=0 (no allocation sampling or MIMALLOC_PROFILE startup profiler) and MI_PROFILE_USE_BUILTIN=1 (the uncalled pprof writer stays compiled), and no override, secure, debug, debug_in_debug, no_thp or local_dynamic_tls feature; native/import closure remains subject to final release verification.
